rows.grounds: tad + hasta; locative compound indicating placement
siṃha-karṇa ornament name with atha and api

items.question: What alternative ornaments may be placed in the hand according to this iconographic prescription?
premises: A bracelet is named as a possible hand ornament.
A lion-ear ornament is named as another possible hand ornament.
The particles present these items as alternative options for the same hand.
items.inference: The hand may be adorned with either a bracelet or a lion-ear ornament.
uncertainties: The precise form of the ornament termed siṃhakarṇa is not specified in this verse.
items.plain_english: Or a bracelet in that hand, or else a lion-ear ornament.
